applies_why: The judge text resolves a collision over Matthew 1:20 between the challenger's chain and the defender's chain, so K-C governs how that collision must be weighed.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: "weighs chain against chain by footing": one reading requires the judge to assess the comparative support of the competing chains; the other permits a bare underdetermination whenever each side has an answer.
why: The judge declares the point underdetermined by noting that each side offered an answer, without weighing the competing chains by their footing as K-C requires.
